get.summary: The Room of the person with this username (case-insensitive), as you may see it: `hidden` is the owner only, `friends` adds accepted friends, `members` adds people who share a Box with the owner. A block in either direction hides it. Missing, not visible, blocked, an unavailable owner, a former username, and a malformed name all answer the same ROOM_NOT_FOUND. Visitors get no owner-only fields (they are null) and no disabled widgets; Top Friends follow their own audience (`items: null` when not yours to see).

Without `year` it spans every year; `month` needs `year`. Any Room you may not see answers ROOM_NOT_FOUND, exactly like `GET /rooms/{username}`.
